title: Invoices collect in a dead-letter queue
brief: At 11:08 UTC a billing team reports that some accepted invoices never appeared in its ledger. Messages arrive through Azure Service Bus.
question: Why do only some invoices fail, and what would you verify before replaying them?

evidence.observation: The producer starts sending invoices with either schema version 1 or 2. The ledger consumer version stays the same.
The dead-letter queue gained 18 messages. A sample has reason MaxDeliveryCountExceeded and schemaVersion=2.
For each sampled invoice, the handler reported unsupported schema version 2 before writing to the ledger, then abandoned the delivery. Version 1 invoices completed.

workedResponse.diagnosis: The ledger consumer repeatedly abandons version 2 invoices after parsing fails. Repeated delivery eventually moves these invoices to the dead-letter queue.
workedResponse.mitigation: Restore consumer compatibility and confirm one version 2 invoice processes. Reconcile ledger IDs before replaying the affected invoices in small batches.
workedResponse.recovery: Verify both schema versions reach the ledger once per invoice and new dead-letter arrivals stop while the backlog drains.
